name: Polk County, IA
findings: Polk County has 2,560 nonprofit organizations. 798 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 660 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Polk County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 30 political organizations here list membership, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.
